context_for_next_testing_agent: Parent Portal (Portal de Padres) fully tested and working. The portal is a 1:1 replica of the Student Portal for parents/guardians. Parent Maria Peres Garcia is linked to student Pepito Peres Rios via the padre_id field in the student document. All parent endpoints (/api/parent/*) require authentication and verify parent-student linkage via verify_parent_student_access(). The sidebar uses green/emerald color scheme to differentiate from student portal (cyan/amber). Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_parent_portal.py with 18 comprehensive tests covering authentication, profile, dashboard, tasks, grades, attendance, and access control.
